listen_address.description: IP address the finger daemon listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

listen_port.description: TCP port the finger daemon listens on. Standard finger port is 79.

userinfo_enabled.description: Whether to display user information (login name, full name, idle time, etc.) when a user is queried.

hostname_enabled.description: Whether to resolve and display hostnames for remote IP addresses.

syslog_enabled.description: Whether to log requests and errors to the system syslog.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections the daemon will accept.

welcome_file.description: Path to the file containing the welcome message shown on client connect (if it exists).

banner_file.description: Path to the file containing the banner shown before user information (if it exists).

items.description: Directory path to search for user info files (e.g., `.plan`, `.project`, `.forward`).

search_dirs.description: Ordered list of directories where the daemon looks for per-user information files.

items.description: Hostname, IP address, or CIDR block (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') allowed to connect.

allowed_hosts.description: Whitelist of hosts permitted to query the finger daemon. Leave empty to allow all.

items.description: Hostname, IP address, or CIDR block (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8') explicitly denied from connecting.

denied_hosts.description: Blacklist of hosts blocked from querying the finger daemon. Empty by default.

longformat_enabled.description: Whether to enable the `-l` long listing format (shows login shell, home directory, etc.).

timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout in seconds for client connections.
